label: A bomb in a red Santa Fe railroad car marked with a cross
description: Seen: a red railroad car, not an engine, carrying Santa Fe markings and something shaped like a cross with white lettering, with a bomb inside it. The name Santa Fe is given as the reason he kept seeing that word.

label: A purple dragon rising out of the ocean
description: A long Chinese-style serpent in shades of purple and lavender with a dark purple fin, dark purple around white eyes with bright green centres, a white mouth, a red tongue and dark purple claws and tail, seen coming up out of the water with part of the tail still in it. He notes he has never seen a purple dragon, only red ones, and does not interpret it.

label: A major minister taken out during his own service
description: Attacks on churches in the days ahead, with a major minister taken out in the middle of his own service, which the Lord is said to call the shock heard around the world, done to bring fear about the revival he is about to bring. Given alongside the warning that a boogeyman is coming because they do not go to war without one.

label: Cryptocurrencies created for car loans and house loans
description: A word he dates to February 2025, received while driving: certain cryptocurrencies would in future be created for housing loans and car loans. He later points to an article discussing exactly that as the word landing.
